description: Looking too deeply into Albrecht's lost grimoires may cause a void-born duplicate to appear, seething with contempt for the one who let it loose and hurling its wrath from afar. It cannot be banished until the book that gave rise to it is destroyed.

name: Shuffling Fragment
description: In its calcified chaos, the Indifference is disjointed even from itself.

name: The Fragmented
description: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest into three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra which their bizarre master must travel.

name: Legacyte
description: Primitive Techrot Hivequeen

name: Techrot Babau
description: The rapid decay of human ingenuity produces daemons. Often found growing on neglected Hell-Scrubbers.

name: Techrot Galliflex
description: This aggressive melee unit dashes at enemies, lashing out with frenzied strikes.

name: Techrot Matmas
description: This tottering, bulbous Techrot creation can inflate bladders to become airborne, raining down destruction on those below.

name: Techrot Miasmite
description: These tiny nodules of Techrot are the diabolic union of an arc welder and a gas can. Usually attacking in groups, they explode as soon as they near their target.

name: Techrot Obsolyte
description: Even redundant technology is given new life through the Technocyte Virus.

name: Techrot Skuzzi
description: Once a simple workstation, the servant has turned against its former masters.

name: Techrot Volatile Galliflex
description: This self-sacrificing unit ignites its subsumed propane tank and then charges its prey, for the survival of the Hive.

name: Scaldra Jaeger
description: This rifle unit has been trained to suppress the enemy with volley after volley of machine gun fire.

name: Scaldra Flayer
description: Quick and lethal. This Scaldra unit has been trained to rush the target and inflict maximum damage with their curved blades.

name: Scaldra Barbican
description: Sporting a ballistic shield, this heavy unit closes the distance while laying down pistol fire. Carries an Efervon gel cannon.

name: Scaldra Harbinger
description: This automated aerial unit tracks and triangulates its target with lasers and then fires a high caliber rifle shot.

name: Scaldra Dedicant
description: This heavily armored, slow moving unit lays down the law with dual Efervon cannons.

name: Scaldra Eradicator
description: This support unit smokes out its target with gas grenades and finishes the job with blows from his massive club.

name: Amethyst Nexifera

name: Arbitration Shield Drone

name: Bau Vasca Kavat
description: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.

name: Black-Banded Bolarola
description: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.

name: Brindle Kubrodon
description: The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts travel in groups and mark the territory surrounding Orokin cooling towers as their own. Kubrodons are a danger best avoided.

name: Burrowing Cryptilex

name: Caustic Cryptilex

name: Common Condroc
